description: Diagnostic flowchart for responding to damaged parts detected in the input product feed of an automated assembly line.

box_1.text: Are the damaged parts also found in the input product?

box_2.text: Store the damaged parts for possible investigation for the quality assurance team.

box_3.text: Continue with a different batch and notify the quality assurance team.

box_5.text: For an example of a pushed through part, see the corrective action procedure introduction.

box_6.text: Follow the over pressed part corrective procedure.

box_7.text: Have the damaged parts been approved by the metrology station?

box_8.text: Measure the parts on the metrology station.

box_9.text: Block the products and notify maintenance team / quality assurance team

box_10.text: Continue producing, but notify quality assurance team
